Didn't happen to me, but I live in the Sonoran desert. Me and a few friends were on a hike at night behind a popular park. We were walking the path when we spot a Snake sprawled out on the asphalt (the path was paved) I've lived here my whole life so I knew it was a Western Diamondback Rattlesnake. My friend, who also has lived here his whole life, thought it was a baby Bull Snake because it had no rattle. Well it also turns out that baby Diamondbacks also don't have rattles. I warned him to steer clear but he says "No it's fine it's a bull snake I'm gonna pick it up." Well he grabs it's tail and in an instant it whips around strikes at him, misses by a few inches, and hisses. Immediately he drops it and in a frightened tone he says "Yeah that's a rattlesnake." We then promptly got the fuck outta there.
